LOVE

My short story for Decker Fantasy Camp 2026.

Featured:

tsuneko (catlover_mimi)69 days ago

What a wonderful yet slightly melancholic story…
The almost entirely monochrome visuals and the emotions conveyed through the understated, understated narrative deeply moved me.

Also, I'm embarrassed to admit I didn't know about Letters from a Cat until I played this game. To think such a wonderful work existed 150 years ago! When I saw the cat in the illustration, it reminded me of Dayan the Cat, my favorite Japanese cat story.
